law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act 2000 (Act No. 21 of 2000)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 17(1); collective, audiovisual and anonymous works 50 years from making/publication, s. 17(3)-(4))
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (protected with economic rights for life + 50 years, s. 17(1))
fair_use_exceptions: Limitations on protection (s. 25); folklore expressions protected in Part V (unconfirmed)
registration_required: No (copyright arises on creation; secondary source; unconfirmed)
notes: WTO member since 9 Jun 1996. A 2000 WIPO table showed no Berne mark; current Berne/WCT/WPPT status not confirmed. WIPO Lex lists latest version 2002.
